name: BillCraft
purpose: BillCraft is a premium, privacy-first business document studio for creating professional invoices, quotations, receipts, estimates, and proforma invoices. Designed for freelancers and small businesses, it brings smart calculations, GST support, customizable templates, and real PDF export into one seamless, browser-based experience.
proposedFeatures: Professional Documents — Create invoices, quotations, receipts, estimates, and proforma invoices with customizable premium templates.
Smart GST & PDF Export — Calculate GST, CGST, SGST, IGST, discounts, and totals instantly, with client-side PDF generation and export.
Privacy-First Processing — No account, backend, or cloud document storage; documents are processed locally in the browser.
plannedCapabilities: Local-only document generation with PDF export

name: Cartora
purpose: Cartora is a smart grocery and household shopping assistant that helps you organize shopping lists, compare unit prices, calculate basket totals, and stay within budget. Designed with a premium interface and a privacy-first, no-account experience, Cartora makes everyday shopping simpler and smarter.
proposedFeatures: Smart Shopping & Budget Guard — Organize grocery essentials, track basket totals, and identify when spending exceeds your planned budget.
Unit Price Comparison & Basket Optimizer — Compare pack values, calculate discounts, and find opportunities to reduce shopping costs.
Privacy-First Experience — No login, backend, or cloud database; calculations run locally in the browser.
plannedCapabilities: Shopping lists with basket totals and budget guard
Unit price comparison and discount calculation

name: NutriLens
purpose: NutriLens is a privacy-first food intelligence webapp designed to help users understand packaged food products by scanning nutrition labels, ingredients, allergens, and barcodes. Make more informed food choices with intelligent label analysis, transparent nutrition insights, and a simple, mobile-first experience.
intendedUsers: People checking food ingredients and allergens
proposedFeatures: Smart Food Scanning — Analyze food-package photos and extract visible product and nutrition information.
Privacy-First Experience — No account, backend, database, or cloud storage required for the local-first core workflow.
Nutrition & Ingredient Intelligence — Review nutrition values, ingredients, allergens, and food-label insights with transparent data validation.
plannedCapabilities: Food-package photo analysis for visible label information
Local-first workflow with no account or cloud storage
Transparent nutrition, ingredient, and allergen review
